about_the_game:
Small town hero. Big city killer. And so many beautiful women…

Middleton’s favourite superhero is no stranger to fighting crime. He’s been protecting his town for years against a variety of villains, both the enhanced kind and the normies.

But when his beautiful nemesis robs the wrong jewellery store, everything changes. There’s a killer on the loose, and this small-town superhero has to team up with a bunch of interesting allies…the photographer with a secret, the detective with a chip on her shoulder, and an old high school crush who now sees him in a new light.

But his most powerful partner just might be the beautiful but ruthless burglar he’s been pursuing for years.

MAKE YOUR CHOICES

Pick the choices that influence dialogue and action in a fully immersive experience where story, art, sound, and music let you be the superhero you’ve always wanted to be.

FIGHT BAD GUYS

Enjoy action-packed fight scenes as you take down criminals and catch supervillains. Get to the truth one punch at a time.

SOLVE THE CASE

Investigate a string of murders, follow the clues and solve the case in this gripping story written by bestselling author Aaron Crash, author of Denver Fury and Barbarian Outcast. 

Finding this killer is going to take a lot of legwork.

Features

  • Interactive detective visual novel

  • Gripping story where superhero theme meets crime-thriller genre

  • Player choices that influence dialogue and action

  • Badass superhero main character

  • Compelling characters

  • Stunning visuals featuring a 2D art style

  • Thrilling action scenes 

  • Rewards and achievements system

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan-capable, Nvidia and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan-capable, Nvidia and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support (Intel processors) or Apple M1 or above (Apple silicon-based processors)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Apple officially supported drivers (Intel processor) Rosetta 2 is required for Apple silicon devices running on either Apple silicon or Intel versions of the Unity Editor

Recommended:

  • Processor: Apple M1 or above (Apple silicon-based processors)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

  • Additional Notes: Apple officially supported drivers (Intel processor) Rosetta 2 is required for Apple silicon devices running on either Apple silicon or Intel versions of the Unity Editor

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer (X64), Windows 11 21H2 (build 22000) or newer (Arm64)
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Hardware vendor officially supported drivers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer (X64), Windows 11 21H2 (build 22000) or newer (Arm64)
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: MASK CITY: CHAPTER ZERO is a detective visual novel that lets you be a superhero, investigating a string of murders. Talk to witnesses, meet allies and fight bad guys. It’s a small-town story with big city spice written by bestselling author Aaron Crash
